stories.headline: Daniels Dislocates That Same Busted Elbow, Mariota Saddles Up in Washington
stories.read: Well pardner, Jayden Daniels popped his left elbow out again, same wing he busted last year, and Dan Quinn says Marcus Mariota starts Sunday against Seattle with no timeline on the kid's return. Mariota's an old mustang, but he can still scramble for real points with his legs, so he's a fine one-ride rental for superflex outfits in a pinch. Bench Daniels, knock every Commanders pass-catcher down a peg, and if you drafted Daniels as your only gunslinger, go rent a horse off the open range today.

stories.headline: Brooks Goes Under the Knife, Chuba Hubbard Owns the Whole Carolina Ranch
stories.read: Jonathon Brooks needs core-muscle surgery and heads to IR for at least six weeks, just when the saloon had crowned him the hot sleeper over Chuba Hubbard. Now Hubbard gets handed the reins on darn near every carry, and the fellas who let him slide all summer just watched cheap gold turn into a bell cow. Ride Hubbard as a sturdy RB2 with room to flood, and keep an eye out: if the Panthers sign old Austin Ekeler, he's a deep-bench spare horse, not a gusher.

stories.headline: Nico Collins' Hamstring Still Barkin', Houston Receivers Stuck in the Mud
stories.read: Nico Collins sat out Wednesday with a Grade 1 hamstring and ain't expected to ride against the Colts, which would make two straight Sundays on the bench. Last week without him, C.J. Stroud still chucked it for 353 yards, but it was tight end Dalton Schultz who hauled in 140 of 'em while no Texans wideout topped 37. If Schultz is sittin' on the open range, stake him now as your tight end rental, and treat Kayshon Boutte as a cheap dart for the money patch, not a sure thing.
